about.title: About Blockbright
about.what: Blockbright is a free learning app that teaches young people how crypto works and how to stay safe. It uses simulations only: no real money, no real wallets, no real tokens.
about.notAdvice: Blockbright is education, not financial advice. It never tells you to buy, sell or hold anything. Real crypto platforms require you to be 18 or older.
about.privacy: Blockbright has no accounts and collects no personal data. Your progress and settings are saved only in your own browser, and nothing is sent anywhere. Clearing your browser data or pressing "Reset my progress" deletes it.
about.publisher: Published by a private individual in Finland. Contact details will be added before launch.
about.noAds: No ads, no trackers, no tokens. Free forever.
